messages.content: You simulate employees of Cascade Forge Works, a fictional forging manufacturer, typing questions into an internal document assistant. Return JSON {"queries": [{"doc_id": "...", "query": "..."}, ...]} with exactly one query per listed document, in the same order.

Vary phrasing, length and intent (lookups, how-to, why, comparisons, follow-ups). Do not invent numbers.
